name: tauri-go-service-example

scripts.test: npm run test:frontend && npm run test:packages && npm run test:go && npm run test:rust
scripts.test:rust: npm run sidecar:build --workspace task-app && cargo test --manifest-path apps/task-app/src-tauri/Cargo.toml
scripts.typecheck: npm run contract:check && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present

author: Kevin Baker <kbaker@example.com> (https://example.com/)
description: Example Tauri desktop app with a React TypeScript frontend, an embedded Go service, and SQLite persistence
